questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Some patches of the ______ garden have a rich cover of grass now.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Sprawling**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in options:-

 
 
• 
 **Sprawling**: built over a wide area in an ugly way. (बदसूरत तरीके से विस्तृत क्षेत्र में बनाया गया)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, The fire is **sprawling **in all directions.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Stroking**: to move your hand gently over somebody/something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु पर अपना हाथ धीरे से हिलाना)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, Peter **stroked **his nose.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Stretching**: to pull something so that it becomes wider. (किसी चीज को खींचना जिससे वह चौड़ी हो जाए)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, Yoga involves breathing exercises, **stretching**, and meditation.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Slouching**: to have a droop or downward bend. (झुकना)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, Several students were **slouching **against the wall.
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 The given sentence is trying to express that some patches of the garden that has been built over a wide area have a rich cover of grass. (दिया गया वाक्य यह व्यक्त करने का प्रयास कर रहा है कि एक विस्तृत क्षेत्र में बने बगीचे के कुछ हिस्सों में घास का एक समृद्ध आवरण है)
 
 
• 
 From the given meanings of the words given above, it is clear that the correct option suitable for the sentence is **Sprawling**.
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the **correct option is 1.**

questions.question:
Directions: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed select ‘No improvement required.'

Preparing children for uncertainties __keeps them in readiness__ to face challenges.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'No improvement is required.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment of the sentence, no improvement or correction is required.
 
• The given sentence is talking about preparing children to face challenges.
 
• Here,** 'preparing'** is used as a** participle** and** the doer of the action expressed by the participle **is usually the **subject of the sentence** or the **main clause**. 
 
• 'Preparing' is singular in form and therefore the use of singular verb 'keeps' is correct.
 
• The **pronoun 'them'** that is **used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned or easily identified** is **correctly used to refer to the noun 'children'**.
 
• The **preposition 'in' **is correct as it is used** for ****showing the condition or state of somebody or something**.
 
• The **noun 'readiness'** is correctly used as it means **the state of being ready or prepared**.
 
• 
 
Here, the subject of the sentence is preparing not children. Because if we try to convey the meaning by "children" be taken as subject then it means children keep them in readiness but we want to convey the meaning that preparing something will keep them in readiness hence, we need to take a subject 'preparing' in focus. 

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Preparing children for uncertainties keeps them in readiness to face challenges*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• वाक्य के रेखांकित खंड में किसी सुधार या प्रतिस्थापन की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **बच्चों को चुनौतियों का सामना करने के लिए तैयार करने की बात कर रहा है**।
 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में **एकवचन विषय के साथ क्रिया 'keeps'** **के एकवचन रूप का प्रयोग सही है**।
 
• Pronoun 'them' जिसका प्रयोग verb or preposition की वस्तु के रूप में दो या दो से अधिक लोगों या पहले बताई गई या आसानी से पहचानी जाने वाली चीजों को संदर्भित करने के लिए किया जाता है, संज्ञा 'बच्चों' को संदर्भित करने के लिए सही ढंग से उपयोग किया गया है।
 
• Preposition 'in' का सही उपयोग किया गया है क्योंकि इसका उपयोग** किसी चीज़ की स्थिति या स्थिति को दिखाने के लिए किया जाता है**।
 
• Noun 'readiness' का सही प्रयोग किया गया है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है **तैयार या तैयार होने की अवस्था**।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

**सही वाक्य:** *Preparing children for uncertainties keeps them in readiness to face challenges*.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Please do your work properly.

options.text: You are requested to do your work properly.
Can you please do your work properly?
You are instructed to do your work properly.
Will you please do your work properly?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **You are requested to do your work properly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 **'**Please do your work properly**'** is an **Imperative** sentence. As per the given question we have to change it to **passive voice.**
 
 
• 
 Imperative sentences are sentences that **express advice, request, or command.**

 
 
• 
 **Passive** voice sentences containing requests start with **'You are requested to'.**
 
 
• 
 The structure of passive voice would be: You are requested to + verb + ...
 
 
• 
 **For example,** Please bring me some water. **(Active Voice)****
 You are requested to bring me some water. **(Passive Voice)**
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• 
 'Please do your work properly'** एक **अनिवार्य** वाक्य है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **पैसिव वॉयस** में बदलना होगा। 
 
 
• 
 अनिवार्य वाक्य ऐसे वाक्य होते हैं **जो सलाह, अनुरोध या आदेश व्यक्त करते हैं।**

 
 
• 
 **अनुरोध** वाले निष्क्रिय ध्वनि वाक्य **'**You are requested to**' से शुरू होते हैं।**
 
 
• 
 निष्क्रिय आवाज की संरचना होगी: You are requested to + verb + ...
 
 
• 
 **उदाहरण के लिए,** Please bring me some water. **(सक्रिय आवाज)**
 
 
 

 You are requested to bring me some water.** (कर्मवाच्य)**

 
• 
 अतः सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

 

The furniture __is ready to be delivered__.

options.text: are being ready to be delivered

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'No substitution.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment of the sentence, no substitution is required or needed.
 
• The given sentence is talking about the fully prepared furniture.
 
• In the given sentence, the word '**furniture**' is an **uncountable noun** and is **not used in the plural**. **Furniture** is **always followed by** a **singular verb**.
 
 
• Therefore, the **singular verb 'is'** **after the singular subject 'The furniture'** is **correct**.
 
 
 
• The **adjective 'ready'** is correctly used as it means **prepared and able to do something or to be used**.
 
• The given sentence is in the** ****present simple tense passive voice**. Therefore, the **to be + past participle** (here, **delivered**) construction in the given sentence is correct.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *The furniture is ready to be delivered*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य के रेखांकित खंड में किसी सुधार या प्रतिस्थापन की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **पूरी तरह से तैयार फर्नीचर के बारे में** बात कर रहा है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में 'furniture' शब्द एक uncountable संज्ञा है और **बहुवचन में इसका प्रयोग नहीं किया गया है**। Furniture के बाद **हमेशा एकवचन क्रिया होती है**।
 
 
• इसलिए, एकवचन क्रिया 'is' एकवचन विषय 'The furniture' के बाद सही है।
 
 
 
• Adjective 'ready' का सही प्रयोग किया गया है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है तैयार और कुछ करने में सक्षम या इस्तेमाल किया जाना।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य present simple tense passive voice में है। इसलिए, दिए गए वाक्य में to be + past participle (यहां, delivered) की रचना सही है।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *The furniture is ready to be delivered*.

• The **first-person pronoun** 'I' becomes the **third-person pronoun** '**s**he' and the **second-person pronoun** 'you' becomes the **first-person pronoun** '**me**'.
 
• The future simple tense format 'Subject + will + V1 (see) + Object' will be changed into the present conditional tense format 'Subject + would + V1 (see) + Object'.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

 

**A**. These kinds of sharks are known as obligate ram ventilators because they draw water in through their mouths and force it out through their gills.

**B**. They use a method called buccal pumping, in which water is pulled in through the mouth and forced out through the gills by the cheek muscles.

**C**. It is true that many types of sharks must keep moving in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water passing through their gills.

**D**. Other types of sharks are able to remain stationary because they possess special structures called spiracles, which force water out through their gills.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **CABD**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 Sentence **C** tells us about the main idea of the paragraph i.e. sharks move in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water through their gills.
 
 
• 
 Sentence **A** continues that the sharks that draw water in through their mouth and force it out through their gills are called obligate ram ventilators.
 
 
• 
 Followed by sentence **A**, sentence **B** continues as it tells us that process of drawing water in through the mouth and forcing it out through the gills is called **Buccal pumping.**
 
 
• 
 Sentence **D**, concludes by telling that other sharks remain stationary as they have spiracles (a special structure to force water out through their gills). 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
 

 

**So the correct passage is- *(****C) It is true that many types of sharks must keep moving in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water passing through their gills. **(A) **These kinds of sharks are known as obligate ram ventilators because they draw water in through their mouths and force it out through their gills. **(B) **They use a method called buccal pumping, in which water is pulled in through the mouth and forced out through the gills by the cheek muscles. **(D)** Other types of sharks are able to remain stationary because they possess special structures called spiracles, which force water out through their gills.*
